question: Which scheme focuses specifically on supporting organic farming?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PKVY**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)** focuses specifically on supporting **organic farming** practices in India. It was launched in **2015** to promote sustainable agriculture and reduce the dependency on chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• Under PKVY, clusters of farmers are encouraged to take up organic farming. Each cluster should consist of **50 or more farmers** with a total area of at least **50 acres**.
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance of up to **₹50,000 per hectare** for a period of three years to support organic farming activities. This includes assistance for **organic certification, training, and the adoption of organic practices**.
 
• **PKVY** aims to promote **traditional agricultural practices**, improve soil fertility, and ensure the production of healthy and chemical-free crops. Farmers are encouraged to use natural inputs like compost, green manure, and bio-pesticides.
 
• The scheme also supports the formation of **Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)** to market organic produce and provide better price realization for farmers.
 
• **PKVY** is implemented in coordination with **State Governments** and emphasizes the creation of market linkages for organically produced crops. Farmers are trained and provided with necessary resources for organic farming.
 
• The scheme is part of the broader **National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)**, which aims to reduce the environmental impact of agriculture and promote eco-friendly farming practices.
 
• **Hence, the correct answer is PKVY.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Schemes Mentioned:**

 
 
• **PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana):** This scheme provides **pension benefits** to small and marginal farmers upon attaining the age of 60 years. It is not related to organic farming.
 
• **Soil Health Card Scheme:** Launched in **2015**, this scheme aims to provide farmers with information about the **nutrient status of their soil** and recommendations for improving soil health. While it is beneficial for agriculture, it does not specifically focus on organic farming.
 
• **ATMA (Agricultural Technology Management Agency):** This scheme is part of the **National Mission on Agricultural Extension and Technology** and aims to strengthen agricultural extension services. It focuses on capacity building and technology dissemination but does not exclusively address organic farming.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of PKVY:**
 
 
• Promote the use of **indigenous practices** in agriculture.
 
• Enhance the **income of farmers** through premium pricing of organic produce.
 
• Reduce the adverse effects of **chemical-based farming** on soil, water, and human health.
 
• Encourage the adoption of **natural and eco-friendly farming methods**.
 
 
 
• **Implementation of PKVY:**
 
 
• Farmers are organized into clusters and provided with training and resources for organic farming.
 
• Emphasis is placed on **organic certification** to ensure the authenticity of produce.
 
• Support is provided for setting up **vermicompost units, biogas units, and other organic farming infrastructure**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Organic Farming in India:**

 
 
• Organic farming involves the use of natural inputs like **organic compost, bio-fertilizers, and bio-pesticides**.
 
• India ranks among the top countries in terms of the number of farmers practicing organic farming, with a significant focus on states like **Sikkim, Uttarakhand, and Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• Organic farming not only improves soil health but also contributes to **environmental sustainability**.
 
 
 
• **Global Trends:**
 
 
• The global market for organic food is growing rapidly, driven by increasing awareness of the **health and environmental benefits** of organic products.
 
• Countries like **Germany, the USA, and Australia** are major markets for organic produce.
